units.source_text: 时人迷信，洗发须择吉日。

en.t: People of the time were superstitious and believed that one had to choose an auspicious day to wash one's hair.

units.source_text: 每年正月、五月、九月是办佛事的，不宜洗发；

en.t: The first, fifth, and ninth months of each year were for Buddhist rites, so it was not suitable to wash one's hair then;

units.source_text: 十月叫作神无月，亦不宜洗发。

en.t: The tenth month was called Kannazuki, the month without gods, and was likewise considered unsuitable for washing one's hair.
